| News Turkiye the only country to move up in Top 20 in the latest FIBA World Ranking 2025-12-04 14:06 Turkiye was the only country to move up in the Top 20 in the latest FIBA World Ranking, while the Top 10 remains unchanged, with the USA in first and Germany in second. Credit: FIBA Credit FIBA Credit FIBA Add us on Share on Facebook Share on Messenger Share on Messenger Share on Twitter/X Share on Whatsapp Share by Email Add us on The latest update of the men’s FIBA World Ranking has been released, with few changes compared to the previous edition. Türkiye / Schedule The only country to move up in the Top 20 was Turkiye, which overtook Latvia to claim 11th place. The Top 10 remains unchanged, with the USA leading the pack with 871.8 points, followed by three European nations: Germany in second, Serbia in third, and France in fourth. Canada also remains in the Top 5, while the rest of the Top 10 is rounded out by Australia, Spain, Argentina, Lithuania, and Brazil, just as in the previous update. https://twitter.com/a/status/1996570182186152271 Among the biggest climbers further down the rankings was Jamaica, which jumped eight spots to 87th after beating Puerto Rico twice during the qualification window.
